tool_args.rationale: The narrow pilot cannot distinguish the recalled mechanisms or identify behavior away from s_grad approximately 1. The open-branch probe directly addresses that ambiguity at the lowest relevant listed cost.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit Cobb–Douglas power law or hydraulic basin model to the pilot
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The five rows vary u_now but keep s_grad near 1 and all other inputs fixed, leaving the gradient dependence and possible branch term unidentified.
The pilot is increasing throughout, so it does not establish the predicted high-input decline; the competing mechanisms also remain unresolved.
A denser trajectory is more costly and is less directly targeted at the open-branch ambiguity.
The nuisance measurement is not relevant to identifying the target law.
